arxiv-2011-13524.title: Qulacs: a fast and versatile quantum circuit simulator for research purpose
arxiv-2011-13524.creator: Yasunari Suzuki, Yoshiaki Kawase, Yuya Masumura, Yuria Hiraga, Masahiro Nakadai, Jiabao Chen, Ken M. Nakanishi, Kosuke Mitarai, Ryosuke Imai, Shiro Tamiya, Takahiro Yamamoto, Tennin Yan, Toru Kawakubo, Yuya O. Nakagawa, Yohei Ibe, Youyuan Zhang, Hirotsugu Yamashita, Hikaru Yoshimura, Akihiro Hayashi
arxiv-2011-13524.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yasunari Suzuki, Yoshiaki Kawase, Yuya Masumura, Yuria Hiraga, Masahiro Nakadai, Jiabao Chen, Ken M. Nakanishi, Kosuke Mitarai, Ryosuke Imai, Shiro Tamiya, Takahiro Yamamoto, Tennin Yan, Toru Kawakubo, Yuya O. Nakagawa, Yohei Ibe, Youyuan Zhang, Hirotsugu Yamashita, Hikaru Yoshimura, Akihiro Hayashi. To explore the possibilities of a near-term intermediate-scale quantum algorithm and long-term fault-tolerant quantum computing, a fast and versatile quantum circuit simulator is needed. Here, we introduce Qulacs, a fast simulator for quantum circuits intended for research purpose.

arxiv-2107-00223.title: Exponential Lower Bounds for Threshold Circuits of Sub-Linear Depth and Energy
arxiv-2107-00223.creator: Kei Uchizawa, Haruki Abe
arxiv-2107-00223.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kei Uchizawa, Haruki Abe. In this paper, we investigate computational power of threshold circuits and other theoretical models of neural networks in terms of the following four complexity measures: size (the number of gates), depth, weight and energy. Here the energy complexity of a circuit measures sparsity of their computation, and is defined as the maximum number of gates outputting non-zero values taken over all the input assignments.

arxiv-2204-03796.title: Electroweak Precision Fit and New Physics in light of W W Boson Mass
arxiv-2204-03796.creator: Chih-Ting Lu, Lei Wu, Yongcheng Wu, Bin Zhu
arxiv-2204-03796.description: Abstract The W W boson mass is one of the most important electroweak precision observables for testing the Standard Model or its extensions. The very recent measured W W boson mass at CDF shows about 7 ​ σ 7\sigma deviations from the SM prediction, which may challenge the internal consistency of the SM.

arxiv-2206-01895.title: Receding Horizon Navigation and Target Tracking for Aerial Detection of Transient Radioactivity
arxiv-2206-01895.creator: Indrajeet Yadav \affilnum 1, Michael Sebok \affilnum 1 and Herbert G Tanner \affilnum 1
arxiv-2206-01895.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Indrajeet Yadav \affilnum 1, Michael Sebok \affilnum 1 and Herbert G Tanner \affilnum 1. The paper presents a receding horizon planning and control strategy for quadrotor-type mav ( mav )s to navigate reactively and intercept a moving target in a cluttered unknown and dynamic environment.

arxiv-2207-13570.title: Sharpness and non-sharpness of occupation measure bounds for integral variational problems Thanks: August 8, 2026.
arxiv-2207-13570.creator: Giovanni Fantuzzi, Ian Tobasco
arxiv-2207-13570.description: Abstract We analyze two recently proposed methods to establish a priori lower bounds on the minimum of general integral variational problems. The methods, which involve either ‘occupation measures’ or a ‘pointwise dual relaxation’ procedure, are shown to produce the same lower bound under a coercivity hypothesis ensuring their strong duality.

arxiv-2301-08397.title: Variable Sampling MPC via Differentiable Time-Warping Function
arxiv-2301-08397.creator: Zehui Lu, Shaoshuai Mou
arxiv-2301-08397.description: Abstract Designing control inputs for a system that involves dynamical responses in multiple timescales is nontrivial. This paper proposes a parameterized time-warping function to enable a non-uniformly sampling along a prediction horizon given some parameters. The horizon should capture the responses under faster dynamics in the near future and preview the impact from slower dynamics in the distant future.

arxiv-2408-03897.title: Speech privacy-preserving methods using secret key for convolutional neural network models and their robustness evaluation
arxiv-2408-03897.creator: 1 st Shoko Niwa, 2 nd Sayaka Shiota, 3 rd Hitoshi Kiya
arxiv-2408-03897.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose privacy-preserving methods with a secret key for convolutional neural network (CNN)-based models in speech processing tasks. In environments where untrusted third parties, like cloud servers, provide CNN-based systems, ensuring the privacy of speech queries becomes essential.

arxiv-2408-10747.title: Singular Kähler-Einstein metrics and RCD spaces
arxiv-2408-10747.creator: Gábor Székelyhidi
arxiv-2408-10747.description: Abstract . We study Kähler-Einstein metrics on singular projective varieties. We show that under an approximation property with constant scalar curvature metrics, the metric completion of the smooth part is a non-collapsed RCD space, and is homeomorphic to the original variety. 1.

arxiv-2410-01294.title: Endless Jailbreaks With Bijection Learning Thanks: Correspondence to brian.huang@windsurf.com and maxtli068@gmail.com
arxiv-2410-01294.creator: Brian R.Y. Huang, Maximilian Li & Leonard Tang
arxiv-2410-01294.description: Abstract Despite extensive safety measures, LLMs are vulnerable to adversarial inputs, or jailbreaks, which can elicit unsafe behaviors. In this work, we introduce bijection learning , a powerful attack algorithm which automatically fuzzes LLMs for safety vulnerabilities using randomly-generated encodings whose complexity can be tightly controlled.

arxiv-2410-08208.title: SPA : 3D SP atial- A wareness Enables Effective Embodied Representation
arxiv-2410-08208.creator: Haoyi Zhu, Honghui Yang, Yating Wang, Jiange Yang, Limin Wang, Tong He
arxiv-2410-08208.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce SPA, a novel representation learning framework that emphasizes the importance of 3D spatial awareness in embodied AI. Our approach leverages differentiable neural rendering on multi-view images to endow a vanilla Vision Transformer (ViT) with intrinsic spatial understanding.

arxiv-2505-12572.description: Abstract A two stage novel generation framework (outline -> section outline -> manuscript) is widely used in long novel generation,(e.g., DOME , Plan&Write , Long Writer ), but study of such framework in ultra long novel(>1M words) reconstruction is little.

arxiv-2510-13285.title: In-Distribution Steering: Balancing Control and Coherence in Language Model Generation
arxiv-2510-13285.description: Abstract Activation steering methods control large language model (LLM) behavior by modifying internal activations at inference time. However, most existing activation steering methods rely on a fixed steering strength, leading to either insufficient control or unadapted intervention that degrades text plausibility and coherence.

pmc-10503289.title: A Comparative Study on Graft and Overall Survival Rates Between Diabetic and Nondiabetic Kidney Transplant Patients Through Survival Analysis
pmc-10503289.creator: Paola García-Padilla, Valentina Dávila-Rúales, Diana C Hurtado, Diana C Vargas, Oscar M Muñoz, Mayra A Jurado
pmc-10503289.description: Background:Patients with diabetes mellitus (DM) have worse graft and overall survival, but recent evidence suggests that the difference is no longer significant.Objective:To compare the outcomes between patients with end-stage kidney disease due to DM (ESKD-DM) and ESKD due to nondiabetic etiology (ESKD-non-DM) who underwent kidney transplantation (KT) up to 10 years of follow-up.Design:Survival analysis of a retrospective cohort.

pmc-11675198.description: Pickering emulsions (PEs) of natural plant proteins enriched in fat-soluble components are gaining consumer interest for healthier and sustainable products. pmc-12458657.title: Randomised, controlled, crossover clinical trial protocol of puerarin for the treatment of metabolic-associated fatty liver disease in China
pmc-12458657.creator: Yu Cui, Xinrui Ren, Jiayi Song, Zhi Shang, Wanchun Zhu, Yiwen Tang, Bowu Chen, Zhuo Yu, Yueqiu Gao, Lingying Huang
pmc-12458657.description: BackgroundAlthough a number of preclinical studies have demonstrated the therapeutic potential of puerarin for metabolic-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD), there is a lack of high-quality clinical evidence. This study aims to evaluate the safety and efficacy of puerarin in patients with MAFLD in a randomised, controlled, crossover trial.Methods and analysisThis study will use the randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial design.

pmc-12596447.title: Artificial intelligence for manuscript writing: policies and implementation in cardiovascular journals
pmc-12596447.creator: Todd A. Laffaye, Brian H. Carlson, William K. Freeman, Chadi Ayoub
pmc-12596447.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a widely used tool for writing, including in scientific research and publications. While its application to cardiovascular research is the focus of numerous studies, the policies related to its use for manuscript writing are rapidly evolving and not well understood.

pmc-12604580.title: Targeting CD20 in Primary Membranous Nephropathy Serologically and Histologically Negative for PLA2R: Is Obinutuzumab Superior to Rituximab?
pmc-12604580.creator: Huiling Cao, Yumei Feng, Xueting Li, Ben Ke, Limin Gong
pmc-12604580.description: BackgroundAnti-CD20 monoclonal antibody has become the first-line treatment option for primary membranous nephropathy (PMN), regardless of PLA2R status. Obinutuzumab (OBZ), a humanized anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody, has shown higher remission rates with an acceptable safety profile over rituximab (RTX), whether in the initial treatment or refractory PLA2R-associated membranous nephropathy.

pmc-12836565.title: Human–machine interaction in computational cancer pathology
pmc-12836565.creator: A Syrnioti, A Polónia, J Pinto, C Eloy
pmc-12836565.description: The performance of the augmented pathologist that works in synergy with artificial intelligence (AI) is generally accepted as the most accurate in comparison to AI standing alone and the general pathologist standing alone. Human–machine interactions triggered by the synergic daily work give rise to trust-related concerns and potential biases that need to be addressed.

pmc-13194156.title: Recent advances in the delivery of natural-product antioxidants for the treatment of breast cancer
pmc-13194156.creator: Fatema Eissa Almansoori, Sungmun Lee
pmc-13194156.description: Breast cancer is one of the main causes of cancer-related death worldwide in women. Conventional treatment of breast cancer, including surgery and chemotherapy, face challenges such as tumor resistance, damaged organs due to the cytotoxicity of anticancer drugs, and poor drug circulation.

pmc-13444316.title: Oncolytic adenovirus incorporating TetO sites in the E1A promoter for controlled replication in TetR-expressing mesenchymal stem cells
pmc-13444316.creator: Ramon Alemany, Silvia Torres-Manjon, Laia Traveset, Rafael Moreno
pmc-13444316.description: Oncolytic viruses are therapeutic agents that combine self-amplification, lytic activity, and immunostimulatory properties. However, their systemic administration is limited by inefficient tumor delivery. Although mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-based carrier systems have been proposed to overcome these barriers, their efficacy is restricted by rapid MSC lysis following viral replication, which limits the time available for tumor homing.

pmc-13450263.title: Effectiveness of a heparin-like glycosaminoglycan from snail mucus in a murine model of dry eye
pmc-13450263.creator: Shangkun Ou, Lingli Zhang, Lisha Lin, Liying Zhang, Hao Jiang, Qiurong Long, Meng Zhang, Xueer Zheng, Xiaoyu Tian, Yiming Wu, Mingyi Wu, Hao Gu
pmc-13450263.description: BackgroundDry eye disease (DED) is a multifactorial ocular surface disorder characterized by tear film instability, inflammation, and epithelial injury, leading to discomfort and visual disturbance. Current treatments remain limited in efficacy and safety. A heparin-like glycosaminoglycan purified from the snail mucus of Achatina fulica (AFG) exhibits potential regenerative and anti-inflammatory properties.

pmc-13555205.title: Enantioselective Determination of Upadacitinib in Pharmaceutical Formulations Using Reversed‐Phase Chiral Liquid Chromatography
pmc-13555205.creator: Sakine Atila Karaca, Sona Aliyeva, Duygu Yeniceli
pmc-13555205.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Stereochemical impurities can significantly alter a drug's pharmacological profile and compromise patient safety even in small levels. Therefore, the development of selective chiral analytical methods is critical for quality control assurance. In this study, a novel chiral HPLC method was developed for the enantiomeric separation and quantification of upadacitinib, a selective JAK‐1 inhibitor used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and Crohn's disease.
